text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day has finally come for Fine Motion to head back to Ireland, yet she still sports her cheerful smile. Throngs of fans show up at the airport to see her off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This speaks clearly to the impact she made and the sheer size of the dream she shared with everyone. And so, with tears in her eyes, Fine Motion returns home.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …However! She's soon back to the academy as a Japan Goodwill Ambassador. She explains that she was chosen because of her outstanding achievements.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With Fine Motion's new duty to "become the bridge between Japan and Ireland" in mind, the two of us set off running once more.
